# LAMMPS Input Script for Surface Energy Minimization

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Define the simulation box
region box block 0 10 0 10 0 10
create_box 1 box

# Read the relaxed surface structure
read_dump /results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/workflow/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_bulk_energy_minimisation_trial_2/relaxed_structure.dump 0 x y z box yes

# Define the potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Define the simulation box and boundary conditions
boundary p p f

# Energy minimization
min_style cg

# Output the energy
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step pe lx ly lz

# Write the minimized structure
write_dump all custom surface_minimized.dump id type x y z
